resources.string: With all parents in your family group. You can pause at any time, but it is never secret: the pause is signed by this phone and your parents are told.
Your screen time is not shared. A parent\'s phone never sends its own usage to anyone.
Your family will see the pause. Time during the pause is still counted on this phone and will be sent when you resume.
Who receives data from this phone, and what exactly.
Sync runs in the background while the family\'s phones are nearby.
Sync is stopped. It stays stopped until you start it here.
Sync needs the Nearby devices permission. Allow it in the app settings.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to sync.
Key storage error: sync cannot run on this phone. Below, under This device, open Diagnostics or use “Reset identity and pair again”.
Bluetooth error. Sync will retry by itself.
A family phone needs a Kinsight update.
No sync yet. Keep the phones close.
Your family will see that sync was stopped and for how long. Nothing is hidden: counting goes on, and the data is sent when you start sync again.
This phone stops receiving your children\'s data until you start sync again.
Warn when a child is out of contact for

This phone gets new keys and is out of the group for good: your family stops getting anything from it, and its old entry stays in their list until an admin removes it. Everything on this phone is deleted: the group, the whole history and the settings. To come back, an admin has to invite this phone and you pair it again from the start. This cannot be undone.
I understand that this cannot be undone
Changing sharing did not finish. Check the switch and try again.
The history setting was not saved, or old history was not removed yet. Try again.
The notification setting was not saved. Try again.
The reset did not finish. Part of the data may already be deleted. Try again.
Your screen time is sent to all parents in your family group, including any who join later. Now:
What is sent: screen time per day and per app, time by hour, the number of unlocks, the app names and icons, and events such as pauses, stopped sync or a hidden notification.
Sharing is off: nothing new is sent, and your family sees that.
To pause: Overview → Pause sharing, or the switch in Settings. To stop sync completely: Stop in the notification or in Settings. Your family sees both.
Parents\' phones keep the data as long as their settings say (by default 90 days in detail and a year of daily totals).
This phone does not share its own screen time with anyone.
It keeps your children\'s data and syncs it with the other parents: %1$s.
On this phone: detailed history %1$s, daily totals %2$s.
Data moves only between your family\'s phones over Bluetooth. Nothing goes to the internet, to servers or to us.
This phone\'s keys cannot be used
Kinsight never makes new keys silently. To continue, reset the identity and pair this phone again. Details: %1$s
This phone is no longer in the group
An admin removed it, or it left. To join again, start over and scan a new invitation.
Starting over did not finish: the old group data could not be deleted. Try again.
